According to documents [2] and [3], first-year undergrad students at UCCS must meet the following admission requirements:

- Be a high school graduate
- Have a minimum GPA of 2.0
- Have a minimum of 13 credit hours of college credit
- Have a minimum of 30 transferable credit hours from another college
- Have a minimum of 72 transferable credit hours from a 2-year institution
- Have a minimum of 90 transferable credit hours from another school
- Have a minimum of 72 credit hours from a 2-year institution

According to documents [3] and [4], UCCS (University of Colorado Colorado Springs) considers the student's cumulative grade point average (GPA) to determine their student classification level. Specifically, the documents state that:

* Freshmen are considered in Good Academic Standing when their cumulative GPA is 2.0 or better.
* Sophomores are considered in Good Academic Standing when their cumulative GPA is 2.0 or better.
* Juniors are considered in Good Academic Standing when their cumulative GPA is 2.0 or better.
* Seniors are considered in Good Academic Standing when their cumulative GPA is 2.0 or better.

To request disability accommodations at UCCS, you can follow these steps:

The waitlist works as follows: 

- Students can add themselves to a waitlist for a class by going to the class registration guide and clicking on the "Add to waitlist if class is full" box.
- The system will automatically enroll students in the class if a seat becomes available or enrollment limits are increased.
- Instructors may accommodate students on the waitlist by requesting to increase their class enrollment limit, or by manually rolling students into the class over the published limit.
- Students on the waitlist will receive an email at their uccs.edu email address if they are automatically enrolled in the class from the waitlist.
